'''Stephen Edward Foots''' {{post-nominals|country=GBR|CBE}} (born September 1968) is a British businessman. He is the chief executive (CEO) of [[Croda International]], a [[FTSE 100 Index|FTSE 100]] British specialist chemicals company.

==Early life==
Foots was born in September 1968,<ref>{{cite web|url=https://beta.companieshouse.gov.uk/company/00206132/officers |title=CRODA INTERNATIONAL PUBLIC LIMITED COMPANY - Officers (free information from Companies House) |website=Beta.companieshouse.gov.uk |date= |accessdate=2016-08-17}}</ref> and raised in the north-east of England. His father’s one-time best friend was football manager [[Brian Clough]]. He has a BSc in chemistry from the [[University of York]].<ref name="Telegraph_01">{{cite web|url=https://www.telegraph.co.uk/finance/financetopics/profiles/9219618/Steve-Foots-Crodas-man-with-the-chemistry-for-success.html |title=Steve Foots: Croda's man with the chemistry for success|publisher=The Telegraph|date=22 April 2012|accessdate=17 November 2012}}</ref>

==Career==
Foots has been chief executive (CEO) of Croda International since 1 January 2012. He has worked for Croda for 21 years, starting as a graduate trainee, and joined the board in July 2010.<ref name=Bloomberg>{{cite web|url=https://www.bloomberg.com/research/stocks/people/person.asp?personId=33713469&privcapId=529256 |title=Steve Foots: Executive Profile |publisher=Bloomberg L.P|date=|accessdate=11 August 2016}}</ref>

In 2014, his total annual remuneration passed £1.4 million.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.yorkshirepost.co.uk/news/croda-s-chief-executive-sees-his-pay-package-break-1-4m-barrier-1-6524320 |title=Croda's chief executive sees his pay package break £1.4m barrier |newspaper=[[Yorkshire Post]] |date=2014-03-27 |accessdate=2016-08-17}}</ref>

==Personal life==
Foots is married with children.<ref name="Telegraph_01" /> He is a keen [[Sunderland A.F.C.]] supporter.<ref name="Telegraph_01" />
